claim: The Public API is designed for individuals and partners without a formal contract.
quote: Start integrating Withings devices into your application with our Public API, designed for individuals and partners without a formal contract.

claim: Withings' other solutions include Cellular, Withings RPM and Logistics Services.
quote: Direct-to-patient dropshipping of pre-configured devices and kits, with personalization options and full API integration.

claim: Withings devices include scales, sleep, trackers, blood pressure and thermometers.
quote: All devices Scales Sleep Trackers Blood Pressure Thermo BeamO U-Scan

claim: Withings' developer home page, captured October 16, 2026, said Withings+ becomes required on the Start for Free API plan from October 12, 2026.
quote: Withings+ becomes required on the Start for Free API plan from October 12, 2026.

claim: Accounts created after that date need a membership to share health data with a free-plan app, including apps already live (October 16, 2026 capture).
quote: Withings accounts created after that date will need a membership to share health data with a free-plan app, including apps that are already live.

claim: Accounts created before that date are unaffected, and Enterprise lifts the requirement for specific use cases (October 16, 2026 capture).
quote: Accounts created before that date are unaffected, and Enterprise lifts the requirement for specific use cases.

claim: There are no prerequisites, and free access is provided on the EU Medical Cloud.
quote: There are no prerequisites, and free access is provided.

claim: The EU Medical Cloud endpoint is https://wbsapi.withings.net.
quote: EU Medical Cloud / Public Cloud https://wbsapi.withings.net

claim: Creating an application provides the client_id and client_secret.
quote: Creating an application will provide you with the necessary client_id and client_secret to access Withings services.

claim: Withings recommends a shared professional email for the developer account.
quote: we recommend creating a new account specifically for your organization using a shared professional email address

claim: Teams have three roles: Admin, Developer and Support Agent.
quote: You can assign them one of three roles: Admin, Developer, or Support Agent.

claim: Only an Admin can manage applications in production.
quote: Create, edit, delete applications in dev, beta, and prod. Yes - -

claim: Users set up their devices in the Withings app before connecting.
quote: Before connecting to your application, the user needs to set up their Withings devices using the Withings app on their phone.

claim: An app whose callback URL misses the requirements is limited to 10 linked users.
quote: If your URL doesn't meet these requirements (e.g. uses HTTP, localhost, or a non-standard port), your application will be limited to 10 linked users. This is intended for development and testing only.

claim: The EU Medical Cloud in France is the default for the Public API.
quote: Hosted in France. The default cloud for Public API and most partner contracts.

claim: The US Medical Cloud is for HIPAA-covered entities that need data onshore.
quote: Hosted in the United States, for entities covered by HIPAA that need their data to stay onshore.

claim: Access to the US cloud is by request.
quote: Request access to the US cloud

claim: The cloud is set when the access contract is created and cannot be switched.
quote: Your cloud is set when your access contract is created and cannot be switched afterwards

claim: The authorization URL is https://account.withings.com/oauth2_user/authorize2.
quote: https://account.withings.com/oauth2_user/authorize2?response_type=code&client_id=YOUR_CLIENT_ID&scope=user.info,user.metrics,user.activity&redirect_uri=YOUR_REDIRECT_URI&state=YOUR_STATE

claim: The state parameter is a CSRF protection mechanism.
quote: The state parameter acts as a CSRF protection mechanism by allowing you to include a unique string with your request.

claim: The authorization code is only valid for 30 seconds.
quote: Please note that the authorization code is only valid for 30 seconds.

claim: You have 30 seconds to exchange the code.
quote: You have 30 seconds to exchange the authorization code for an access token and a refresh token.

claim: user.activity covers activity and sleep and is required for notification management.
quote: Get data related to user physical activity and sleep activities. Also required for notification management.

claim: user.metrics covers health measurements, heart recordings, stethoscope data and goals.
quote: Get data related to user health measurements, heart recordings, stethoscope data, and user goals. Also required for notification management.

claim: user.info covers account information, linked devices and goals, and device linking.
quote: Access user account information, linked devices, goals, and manage device linking.

claim: user.sleepevents covers sleep-event notifications.
quote: Scope used to receive notifications when sleep events happen (bed in, bed out, inflate done).

claim: mode=demo logs in as a demo user.
quote: you can use the optional parameter mode with the value demo . You will be redirected to the authorisation page and automatically logged in as a demo user.

claim: Partners must sign some requests using HMAC SHA-256.
quote: To securely interact with Withings APIs, partners must sign some of their requests using HMAC SHA-256 .

claim: The nonce comes from the Signature v2 getnonce endpoint.
quote: This is done by invoking the Signature v2 - Getnonce endpoint.

claim: Every request requires a fresh nonce.
quote: The nonce is a transient token, and every request requires a fresh one.

claim: The HMAC key is the client secret.
quote: The secret key for the HMAC function is your client secret

claim: The token exchange is the requesttoken action.
quote: action: 'requesttoken',

claim: The token exchange is posted to /v2/oauth2.
quote: await axios.post(API_ENDPOINT + '/v2/oauth2', params);

claim: The access token expires after 3 hours.
quote: access_token : Expires after 3 hours

claim: The refresh token expires after 1 year.
quote: refresh_token : Expires after 1 year

claim: The old refresh token expires 8 hours after a new one or once the new access token is used.
quote: Old refresh_token : Expires 8 hours after new issuance or once the new access_token is used

claim: Each refresh returns a new refresh token; failing to replace it can lose access.
quote: Important: Always replace the previous refresh_token with the new one. Failure to do so may result in losing access once the old refresh_token expires.

claim: Once authorized, you access all historical health data collected by the devices.
quote: you will have access not only to new data but also to all historical health data collected by the devices

claim: getmeas on the measure service is the endpoint for weight.
quote: The snippet calls getmeas on the measure service

claim: The fetch example posts to https://wbsapi.withings.net/measure.
quote: axios.post('https://wbsapi.withings.net/measure', data, {

quote: Call Measure v2 - Getactivity → Call Measure v2 - Getintradayactivity → Call Measure v2 - Getworkouts →

claim: Sleep v2 get and getsummary serve sleep.
quote: Call Sleep v2 - Get → Call Sleep v2 - Getsummary →

claim: Heart v2 list serves ECG recordings.
quote: Call Heart v2 - List →

claim: Blood pressure, heart rate and SpO2 come through getmeas.
quote: A new blood pressure measurement (and heart rate, when supported) was recorded.

claim: Glucose comes through getmeas.
quote: A new glucose measurement was recorded.

claim: lastupdate returns everything created or modified since, including missed updates.
quote: For ongoing sync, we recommend lastupdate instead: pass the timestamp of your last successful fetch and the Data API returns everything created or modified since, including any updates you missed if a notification was lost.

claim: The catalogue lists 96 biomarkers across 9 device families.
quote: 96 biomarkers across 9 device families

claim: Some biomarkers require the Advanced Biomarkers plan.
quote: Requires the Advanced Biomarkers plan

claim: Withings POSTs a notification and your handler fetches the data.
quote: Withings POSTs to your callback URL the moment new measurements arrive, then your handler fetches the data via the Data API.

claim: Subscribe a callback URL to a category with the subscribe action on the notify service.
quote: action: 'subscribe',

claim: The subscribe call posts to the notify service.
quote: axios.post('https://wbsapi.withings.net/notify', data, {

claim: Each category is identified by an integer called appli.
quote: Each notification category is identified by an integer called appli .

claim: Category 1 is weight and body composition.
quote: A new weight or body composition measurement was recorded by a Withings scale.

claim: Category 16 is activity.
quote: New activity data is available — steps, distance, calories, intensity, or workouts.

claim: Category 44 is the sleep summary.
quote: New sleep data is available — duration, sleep state, deep/light state duration (no REM), and wakeup counts.

claim: Notifications carry userid, appli and a start and end date.
quote: Three fields matter: userid tells you which user the measurement belongs to, appli indicates which data category was updated

claim: Callback URLs must be HTTPS only.
quote: HTTPS only — plain HTTP URLs are not accepted

claim: No IP addresses or localhost.
quote: No IP addresses or localhost — must be a proper domain name

claim: Ports 80 or 443 only.
quote: Ports 80 or 443 only — non-standard ports are not supported in production

claim: At most 255 characters.
quote: Max 255 characters

claim: The URL must answer HEAD with a 2xx.
quote: Withings sends a HEAD request to verify your URL is reachable before registering it. Make sure your server handles HEAD and returns a 2xx status code.

claim: Withings retries on a schedule, 2 attempts per cycle and 10 in total.
quote: Each cycle does 2 HTTP attempts (10 attempts total).

claim: The retry cycles run over about 5 hours.
quote: Per notification — 5 retry cycles over ~5 hours

claim: Withings retries when the endpoint does not answer below 400.
quote: If your endpoint doesn't return HTTP < 400 , Withings retries the same notification on this schedule:

claim: 4 failed notifications in a row trigger warning emails.
quote: 4 failed notifications in a row → A warning email is sent for each (max 4 emails).

claim: 20 days of failures cancel the subscription.
quote: 20 days of unresolved failures → Subscription is auto-cancelled, with a final notice email.

claim: Missed notifications are not redelivered; backfill with lastupdate.
quote: Missed notifications are not redelivered. Once your endpoint is back up, backfill via the Data API using lastupdate .

claim: Typical delivery is under 2 minutes, with no real-time SLA on the standard plan.
quote: Withings does not commit to a real-time SLA on the standard plan.

claim: Typical delivery delay is under 2 minutes.
quote: Typical delivery delay is under 2 minutes

claim: Withings publishes its notification IP ranges as DNS TXT records.
quote: The current IP ranges are published as DNS TXT records, queryable with dig :

claim: The EU record is ipblock-notify.withings.net.
quote: dig +short TXT ipblock-notify.withings.net

claim: Withings suggests a secret query parameter on the callback URL.
quote: When you set the callback URL on your subscription, append a query parameter only you and Withings know.

claim: The handler should answer within a few seconds.
quote: Your endpoint returns HTTP 2xx within a few seconds.

claim: The standard API enforces 120 requests per minute across your application.
quote: The standard Withings API enforces a 120 requests-per-minute limit across your application

claim: The Enterprise plan unlocks higher limits and dedicated support.
quote: If your use case demands a higher request rate or stricter SLA guarantees, the Enterprise plan unlocks higher limits and dedicated support.

claim: Major changes get one month's notice, up to three months for business-critical ones.
quote: One month - Up to three months for a Business Critical change

claim: Emergency changes come with up to two weeks or no notice.
quote: No notification - Up to two weeks

claim: Normal changes have no impact and no notification.
quote: There is no impact on partner integration. No action required on partner integration of the Service No notification

claim: Withings publishes breaking changes and deprecations on a developer updates portal.
quote: Withings tracks the Service breaking changes and deprecations at the following location:

claim: The developer application's contact email is added to the mailing list automatically.
quote: the contact email address used to register your Developer Application will be automatically added to the email mailing list.

claim: Access tokens are short-lived; an expired one returns 401.
quote: Access tokens are short-lived, so check the expiry and refresh with the refresh token if needed — otherwise the Data API rejects the call with 401 Unauthorized .
